request.style: English, male baritone solo with deep choir, electric guitar, bass guitar, drums, acoustic guitar, organ, serious and grounded mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the hill country of Seir the line began
Esau the father of the Edomites is named
Eliphaz his firstborn son from Adah came
And the chiefs among his descendants rose to fame

[Chorus]
Chief Teman and Chief Omar stand tall
Chief Zepho and Chief Kenaz answer the call
Descended from Eliphaz in the land of Edom
Their history is written in the family song

[Verse]
The sons of Eliphaz are listed by name
Teman Omar Zepho Gatam and Kenaz are the same
They formed the foundation of the tribes so dear
Settled in the mountains for generations near

[Chorus]
Chief Teman and Chief Omar stand tall
Chief Zepho and Chief Kenaz answer the call
Descended from Eliphaz in the land of Edom
Their history is written in the family song

[Bridge]
From Adam to the end the genealogy flows
One Chronicles confirms what the record knows
Omar is a chief in the line of Esau
His place in the history is firmly drawn

[Outro]
Chief Omar is named in the book of Genesis
A tribal leader in the land of Edom
